work_items.title: Publish the master-backed Fawxzzy project board
work_items.summary: The read-only FawxzzyWeb /projects experience is source-proven against the provider-neutral project-board contract and is waiting for the remaining canonical owner export before final generation and guarded publication.
work_items.objective: Publish a responsive, accessible read-only project-board experience from current owner exports and the master public read model without restoring DiscordOS as a runtime dependency or exposing private evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Current FawxzzyWeb main contains the read-only /projects consumer with no runtime or build dependency on DiscordOS.
Every displayed card retains its stable project, card, owner, lifecycle, relationship, and source-revision identity.
Public output excludes provider identifiers, private evidence, secrets, raw transcripts, and privileged credentials.
Lifecycle counts, completed history, stale-source behavior, accessibility, and narrow-screen interaction pass deterministic verification.
Source publication and production release remain separate guarded owner boundaries.
discoveries: The canonical Fitness owner export is complete and merged.
The prior FawxzzyWeb /projects implementation is reusable design evidence but its retired DiscordOS-backed generator is not authoritative.
SOC-024 remains Socials OS program work and is not duplicated onto the FawxzzyWeb owner board.
next_actions: Consume the canonical Mazer owner export when it becomes available.
Regenerate the project-board read model from the complete active-project owner-export set.
Rebase the source-proven /projects implementation onto current FawxzzyWeb main and run the guarded publication lifecycle.
blockers: The canonical active/planned Mazer owner export is not yet available for deterministic final read-model generation.

excluded_records.reason: The issue records an April Trove deployment incident superseded by later verified FawxzzyWeb production releases; an open provider incident log is not current website work.

SOC-024 is the stable Socials OS owned-distribution program record. Its remaining profile-routing work stays on the Socials OS board; the completed website migration portion is provenance, not a second FawxzzyWeb card.
The root UI standards candidate remains explicitly unplanned with projection authorization false and therefore is not current active, planning, or blocked owner work.
